drum.chain: EQ (HPF 25 Hz) -> Comp (3:1, 10 ms attack, glue) -> Saturation (tape, 3-5% THD) -> Limiter (-6 dBFS ceiling)

bass.chain: EQ (mono-below-120 filter) -> Comp (4:1, sidechain-ready) -> Saturation (tube, 6-9% THD)

synth.chain: EQ (broad carve) -> Comp (2.5:1, glue, 20 ms attack) -> Stereo Widener (post-comp)

fx.chain: EQ (carve vs. Synth Bus) -> Reverb Return -> Limiter (-8 dBFS ceiling, safety only)

master.chain: EQ (broad tonal balance) -> Bus Comp (2:1, 30 ms attack, 3 dB max GR) -> Saturation (0.5-1% THD, glue) -> Limiter (True Peak -1.0 dBTP)

parallel_compression.reasoning: Heavy 40-60% wet blend creates the signature trap pump; short release (60-100 ms) lets the 808 breathe between kick hits at 147.5 BPM.

kick.exclusive_claim: 40-70 Hz 808 fundamental; no other track may boost here.

bass.exclusive_claim: 30-120 Hz 808 glide lane; sidechain-time-sliced with Kick.

chords.exclusive_claim: 250-500 Hz; -3.5 dB at 320 Hz for 808 room.

melody.exclusive_claim: 800 Hz-3 kHz presence priority; every other track yields here.

arp.exclusive_claim: 3-6 kHz; -3 dB notch at melody presence peak.

pads.exclusive_claim: Side channel only; mid scooped -2 dB at 1-2 kHz.

fx.exclusive_claim: Above 8 kHz for sweeps; never simultaneously with melody peak.

percussion.exclusive_claim: 6-12 kHz hi-hat zone; -3 dB at 6.3 kHz for sharpness control.

intro.exclusive_claim: Exists only before the first full drop; muted thereafter.

streaming.notes: Platform-normalised on ingest; delivering hotter than -14 only reduces PLR. Stem naming: trap_gen{N}_seed_{id}_{track}_v{ver}.wav

broadcast.notes: EBU R128 ±0.5 LU tolerance; anything outside is rejected at ingest.

sync_licensing.notes: Stems mandatory. Include instrumental and vocal stem splits. 808 stem separate.
